notes: NEX Standards Feed · founder-authorised 2026-09-12. Append-only, versioned, provenance-backed registry of engineering standards. Only the founder authorises admission. Specialists cannot publish directly.
constitutional_purpose_locked: The Standards Feed is not learning. It is an authorised engineering standards registry. Only chain: SPECIALIST → EVIDENCE VALIDATION → NEX2 → NEX3 → FOUNDER → STANDARD → FEED → NEX1.

standard_states.SUPERSEDED: replaced by a newer standard · preserved in history
standard_states.DEPRECATED: no longer approved · founder-authorised deprecation with reason

required_fields.name: scope
required_fields.shape: string · what code / subsystem / behaviour this standard binds

required_fields.name: applicability
required_fields.shape: explicit list of paths / subsystems where the standard applies

required_fields.name: exclusion_list
required_fields.shape: explicit list of paths / subsystems where the standard does NOT apply

required_fields.name: cited_evidence_ids
required_fields.shape: array of AuthoritativeEvidenceRecord ids supporting admission

required_fields.name: rollback_reference
required_fields.shape: how to reverse this standard's effect

invariants: APPEND-ONLY · MUST NEVER mutate an APPROVED entry · SUPERSEDED preserves history
MUST NEVER accept a standard without a NEX3 arbitration_id and founder authorisation token
MUST NEVER accept a standard proposed directly by a specialist (bypassing NEX2/NEX3)
MUST NEVER accept a standard whose cited_evidence_ids include a record with validation_verdict != VALIDATED
the Feed is NOT 'learning' · it is an authorised registry
rollback_reference is MANDATORY · every standard is reversible
